result.summary: Found 1 issue: the featured restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section failed to load and shows a broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section, the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a gray box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, while the delivery badge and favorite button still render over the empty area.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source so the restaurant photo loads, and use a branded fallback or retry state instead of the generic broken-image icon.
